turn_prompts: Generate a reproducible task Dockerfile from the approved task design. The host request document includes frozen_environment_policy.base_image: use that exact value, unchanged, in every FROM instruction; do not guess it and do not substitute the base64 input value. Do not use tag-only, digest-only, ARG-expanded, substituted, or additional base images. For a non-zero-to-one task, clone the frozen GitHub repository and check out the exact frozen commit without credentials. Never use COPY . ., ADD . ., wildcard task-root sources, external contexts, or broad task-root transfer sources; enumerate only the minimal required files. COPY/ADD --from may reference only an earlier local build-stage alias or numeric index; RUN --mount=from may reference only an earlier local build-stage alias. Do not use ONBUILD or Dockerfile parser directives. When invoking the stage-private harbor_submit_stage_output dynamic tool, set the sole artifact content_base64 to the standard base64 encoding of the final environment/Dockerfile bytes themselves. The decoded payload must be a raw Dockerfile, not a JSON object, format/version envelope, dockerfile field, artifact-name field, Markdown code fence, or explanatory wrapper. Do not finish with prose alone; only an accepted tool submission is a stage result.
